description_en: Queries the list of model templates
name: ListModelTemplates

parameters.help_en: The Agent provider list. Supports Common. If specified together with AgentProvider, AgentProvider takes precedence and this list is ignored. To query Common model groups, explicitly include COMMON in the platform filter
parameters.help_zh: Agent提供商列表（支持 Common；与 AgentProvider 同时传时以 AgentProvider 为准，本列表被忽略）；查询 Common 模型分组时须在平台筛选中显式包含 COMMON
parameters.name: agent_provider_list

parameters.help_en: The Agent platform list. Supports COMMON. If specified together with AgentPlatform, AgentPlatform takes precedence and this list is ignored. Defaults to ENTERPRISE if no platform filter is specified. To query Common model groups, explicitly include COMMON. If filtering by Provider simultaneously, set the value to Common
parameters.help_zh: Agent平台列表（支持 COMMON；与 AgentPlatform 同时传时以 AgentPlatform 为准，本列表被忽略）；平台筛选均未传时默认 ENTERPRISE，查询 Common 模型分组须显式包含 COMMON，如同时按 Provider 过滤，取值为 Common
parameters.name: agent_platform_list

parameters.help_en: The list of template group IDs to filter by
parameters.name: model_template_id_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether models are configured in the group
parameters.name: has_model

parameters.help_en: The authorization scope filter. Valid values: ALL_USER, USER_MIXED, or RESOURCE_MIXED (strictly uppercase. Case variants or unknown values return InvalidParameter). If not specified, no filtering is applied. Unlike create/update operations, the filter scenario allows RESOURCE_MIXED (to filter non-Common model groups)
parameters.help_zh: 授权范围筛选，取值 ALL_USER / USER_MIXED / RESOURCE_MIXED（严格大写，大小写变体与未知取值报 InvalidParameter）；不传时不过滤。与创建/更新接口不同，过滤场景允许 RESOURCE_MIXED（即筛选非 Common 模型分组）
parameters.name: ref_scope

parameters.help_en: The model group name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 模型分组名称，模糊匹配
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The template source filter. Valid values:
User: tenant-created (default if not specified).
System: system preset
parameters.help_zh: 模板来源筛选：User-租户自建（不传时默认），System-系统预置
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. Values 0 and 1 return the same result
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从1开始，0和1返回相同结果
parameters.name: page_number

Data.description_en: The list of returned data objects

AgentPlatform.description_en: The Agent platform (such as ENTERPRISE or ENTERPRISE_JVS)

Config.description_en: The model group configuration JSON object
Config.description_zh: 模型分组配置 JSON 对象

HasModel.description_en: Specifies whether models are configured in the group
HasModel.title_en: 该模型模板底下是否存在 LLM 模型
HasModel.title_zh: 该模型模板底下是否存在 LLM 模型

ModelCount.description_en: The number of models in the model group, including referenced system provider models
ModelCount.description_zh: 模型分组内的模型数量（含引用的系统 Provider 模型数量）
ModelCount.title_en: 模型分组内的模型数量（含引用的系统 Provider 模型数量）
ModelCount.title_zh: 模型分组内的模型数量（含引用的系统 Provider 模型数量）

RefScope.description_en:
The group authorization scope. Valid values:
ALL_USER: all users.
USER_MIXED: user mixed (a mix of user groups and users, only for Common groups)
RefScope.description_zh: 分组授权范围：ALL_USER-全部用户 / USER_MIXED-用户混合（用户组和用户混合，仅 Common 分组）
RefScope.title_en: 分组授权范围：ALL_USER-全部用户 / USER_MIXED-用户混合（用户组和用户混合，仅 Common 分组）
RefScope.title_zh: 分组授权范围：ALL_USER-全部用户 / USER_MIXED-用户混合（用户组和用户混合，仅 Common 分组）

UserCount.description_en: The number of authorized users in the group. Returned only when ListModelTemplates is called with refScope=USER_MIXED. Otherwise null
UserCount.description_zh: 分组授权用户数（仅 ListModelTemplates 且 refScope=USER_MIXED 时返回，其余为 null）
UserCount.title_en: 分组授权用户数（仅 ListModelTemplates 且 refScope=USER_MIXED 时返回，其余为 null）
UserCount.title_zh: 分组授权用户数（仅 ListModelTemplates 且 refScope=USER_MIXED 时返回，其余为 null）

UserGroupCount.description_en: The number of authorized user groups in the group. Returned only when ListModelTemplates is called with refScope=USER_MIXED. Otherwise null
UserGroupCount.description_zh: 分组授权用户组数（仅 ListModelTemplates 且 refScope=USER_MIXED 时返回，其余为 null）
UserGroupCount.title_en: 分组授权用户组数（仅 ListModelTemplates 且 refScope=USER_MIXED 时返回，其余为 null）
UserGroupCount.title_zh: 分组授权用户组数（仅 ListModelTemplates 且 refScope=USER_MIXED 时返回，其余为 null）

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number of the query results
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前展示的查询结果页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of query results per page

RequestId.title_en: 请求ID，用于标识请求的唯一 ID
RequestId.title_zh: 请求ID，用于标识请求的唯一 ID

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of query results
